slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Arrays
slides.narration: Let's solve Largest Range, a hard arrays problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: [lo, hi] of the longest run of consecutive integers present in the array.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. lo, hi of the longest run of consecutive integers present in the array.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Only start counting at a number that has no predecessor, so each run is scanned exactly once.
slides.narration: Only start counting at a number that has no predecessor, so each run is scanned exactly once.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Put all numbers in a set
2. For each number without number minus one, extend upward
slides.narration: Step by step. First, put all numbers in a set. Second, for each number without number minus one, extend upward. Third, track the longest run's bounds.
